description: Broad 100-case research prompt pool spanning business and personal use cases. It is designed for seeded random sampling so workflow tests can exercise varied real-user intents without hardcoding expected facts.

answer_key_policy.notes: This pool is for broad workflow coverage. Cases define prompt intent, category, shape tags, and visible required entities when the user explicitly named them, but they do not prescribe a final answer text.

sampling_policy.note: When the caller requests fewer cases than the pool contains, the eval runner should draw a deterministic seeded subset and record the seed in the report.
